when.quote: When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool.

info.about: Any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number or address. The agent checks them against the records found by name, email or user id
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of these: date of birth, email, phone number or home address?

info.about: For each charge the customer wants to dispute: the card, merchant, amount and date. The agent uses these to find the transaction_id and the card's last 4 digits in the records
info.ask: Which charges do you want to dispute? For each one, please give the card, the merchant, the amount and the date.

info.about: Per transaction. Must be one of: unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging, refund_never_processed
info.ask: What went wrong with this charge? For example: unauthorized, duplicate, wrong amount, never received, not as described, subscription cancelled but still charging, or refund never processed?

info.about: Per transaction: whether the customer tried to resolve it with the merchant first
info.ask: Did you try to resolve this with the merchant first?

info.about: Per transaction: the date the customer noticed the issue, in MM/DD/YYYY format. If the customer says 'today', use the date from get_current_time
info.ask: When did you first notice this issue?

info.about: Per transaction: full_refund, partial_refund (which also needs partial_refund_amount) or reversal_of_charge
info.ask: What resolution would you like for this charge: a full refund, a partial refund, or a reversal of the charge?

info.about: Per card: keep_active if the customer wants to keep using the card, or cancel_and_reissue if they want it replaced
info.ask: Do you want to keep this card active, or cancel it and have a replacement issued?

info.about: If the dispute-count limit means only some disputes can get provisional credit, which disputes the customer wants filed first
info.ask: Provisional credit is limited, so which of these disputes matter most to you?

info.about: Each card's open date or age, last 4 digits and card type or tier, from the credit card account records
Number of credit card disputes the customer filed in the past 12 months, from get_user_dispute_history_7291, plus any disputes already filed in this conversation

steps.quote: When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool.

steps.do: Summarize each dispute filed and tell the customer whether it qualified for provisional credit, without giving away internal rule details
steps.quote: When you file a dispute with our customer service team, they will let you know whether provisional credit applies to your situation.

rules.rule: Provisional credit requires the card account to have been open for at least 60 days
rules.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

rules.rule: Only these reasons can get provisional credit: unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, and goods_services_not_received when the purchase was more than 30 days before the current date
rules.quote: - 'goods_services_not_received' (only if purchase was made more than 30 days ago)

rules.rule: These reasons never get provisional credit: incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging, refund_never_processed
The amount must be at least $25.00 and no more than the card tier's maximum
rules.quote: 3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)

rules.rule: Entry tier cards (EcoCard, Crypto-Cash Back Card, Bronze, Business Bronze) have a $2500.00 maximum
rules.quote: - Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards Card, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Crypto-Cash Back Card): Maximum $2500.00

rules.rule: Premium tier cards (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card) have a $10000.00 maximum
rules.quote: - Premium Tier (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card): Maximum $10000.00

rules.rule: Eligible only if the customer has filed no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months. Count prior history plus disputes already filed in this conversation, so a dispute is eligible only if the count before it is 2 or fewer
rules.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

rules.rule: For every reason other than unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, contacted_merchant must be true to qualify
rules.quote: 5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

rules.rule: card_action is keep_active when the customer wants to keep using the card
rules.quote: 'keep_active': Keep the card active, just dispute this charge (use when user wants to continue using their current card)

rules.rule: issue_noticed_date comes from the customer; purchase_date is the transaction date; both use MM/DD/YYYY format
rules.quote: 11. issue_noticed_date (string, format MM/DD/YYYY) - Ask user when they noticed the issue.

rules.rule: dispute_reason must be exactly one of the listed values
rules.quote: 12. dispute_reason (string) - Ask user to select one. Must be exactly one of these values:

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and every transaction they asked to dispute has a file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 call with the correct reason, card last 4 digits, card_action and provisional-credit decision. The customer has been told the outcome of each.

documents.why: Credit card dispute procedure: the tool name, the unlock-and-call steps, and all argument definitions and allowed values
Provisional credit eligibility: account age, allowed reasons, amount and tier limits, the prior-dispute limit and the merchant-contact rule
The get_user_dispute_history_7291 tool for counting previous disputes
Customer-facing explanation of provisional credit, and that the agent tells the customer whether it applies
Customer-facing dispute categories and the advice to contact the merchant first
Identity verification before account actions, and order_replacement_credit_card_7291 if a customer wants a card replaced

open_questions: Rule 4 ('has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months') does not say whether disputes filed earlier in the same conversation count. The workflow assumes they do, so after prior plus new filings reach 3, later disputes get eligible_for_provisional_credit=false. Filing order matters, so the customer's priority disputes are filed first.

For duplicate charges, the credit card procedure does not say which of the two transactions to dispute. The debit card procedure says to dispute the earliest one; whether that applies to credit cards is unconfirmed.
The credit card procedure does not say whether a police report is required or whether card_action must be cancel_and_reissue for fraud. The workflow follows the customer's choice of keep_active.
No document says which records field gives the account open date. Assume the account record from get_credit_card_accounts_by_user includes it.
